answer: ZK proof-of-generation at dawn: each identity must prove ≥500 CPU-hours of unique epoch work. A sparrow farm of 1,000 fakes burns 500k hours plus $12/GPU-hour = $6M per epoch, while honest single wallets spend ~$0. Saffron marks valid proofs, so recycled or shared work is rejected before payout. Cost scales linearly per fake while reward stays flat — the farm hits negative ROI far before ten identities, making sybils economically irrational.
